items.title: AWS End User Messaging adds registration improvements for faster, higher-quality submissions
items.blurb: AWS End User Messaging now makes it easier to complete messaging registrations correctly the first time, with clearer guidance, explicit field requirements, and help avoiding the most common rejection reasons.

items.title: AWS End User Messaging now supports Brand Profiles
items.blurb: Today, AWS End User Messaging announces Brand Profiles, which let you store your brand and company information once and reuse it across your messaging registrations.

items.title: AWS End User Messaging adds a guided wizard for RCS registration videos
items.blurb: Today, AWS End User Messaging adds a wizard that orchestrates the entire video capture for your RCS agent registration.

items.title: AWS End User Messaging now offers managed OTP verification end-to-end
items.blurb: Today, AWS End User Messaging announces end-to-end managed one-time passcode (OTP) verification in Notify.

items.title: Amazon Braket now in scope for FedRAMP Class C
items.blurb: Amazon Braket is now in scope for FedRAMP Class C in AWS US Regions where Braket is available.

items.title: AWS Transform for migrations is now available in Asia Pacific (Singapore)
items.blurb: AWS Transform for migrations is now available in the Asia Pacific (Singapore) Region, giving customers data residency within the region and lower latency to local source infrastructure as they migrate.
